products.name: Organic Tomatoes
products.description: Freshly harvested country tomatoes (Naati) plucked this morning. Tart, juicy, full of natural aroma without synthetic ripeners.

products.name: Red Onions
products.description: Crisp, firm sun-cured Karnataka red onions. Strong natural pungent flavor ideal for curries, sambar, and salads.

products.name: Premium Rice (Sona Masoori)
products.description: Fine grain, lightweight, aromatic Sona Masoori rice aged 12 months for soft and fluffy cooking. Perfect for everyday South Indian meals.

products.name: Clay Cooking Pot
products.description: Kiln-fired earthenware pot handcrafted from virgin riverbed clay. Seasoned for curries, dal, and slow earthenware cooking that locks in authentic village flavor.

products.name: Wooden Elephant Showpiece
products.description: Intricately hand-turned and carved wooden elephant figurine made with heritage ivory-wood (Aale Mara) and polished with vegetable lacquer.

products.name: Cotton Saree (Handloom)
products.description: Pure handloom cotton saree hand-woven by master weavers of Karnataka. Breathable, elegant green temple border, ideal for festive and daily comfort.

products.name: Sandalwood & Turmeric Herbal Soap (2 Pack)
products.description: Handmade cold-process soap crafted with genuine Mysore sandalwood oil, organic Kasturi turmeric, and virgin coconut base. Soothing and deeply nourishing.

specifications.label: Key Ingredients
specifications.value: Sandalwood Oil, Kasturi Turmeric, Virgin Coconut

products.name: Devaraja Market Pure Ghee Mysore Pak
products.description: Crafted following the historic royal Wadiyar recipe with hand-roasted gram flour, simmered in golden desi butter ghee. Melts effortlessly on tongue.

products.name: Farm-Fresh Country Brown Eggs (Free Range)
products.description: Laid by free-grazing native Aseel breed hens fed on sorghum, greens, and grains. Deep orange yolks rich in omega-3.

products.name: Hand-Pounded Organic Sona Masuri Raw Rice
products.description: Grown along the Tungabhadra river plains and aged for 12 months. Single-polish retains wholesome nutrient bran layer.

products.name: Ilkal Handloom Cotton Stole / Scarf
products.description: Handwoven by master weavers in Bagalkot district featuring the distinctive Tope Teni border and natural dyed combed cotton.

products.name: Cold Infused Pure Forest Honey (Nilgiri Flora)
products.description: Harvested sustainably by indigenous honey hunters from wild hives in Western Ghats foothills. Unpasteurized and full of natural pollen.
